summary: Created in doing. A stalled download is terminal on the first blip: the watchdog error string matches no transport pattern, so no mirror failover, and no same-url retry exists. Cost a 25GB LTX transformer at 8.4GB.

Fix implemented: same-url retry gated on bytes-on-disk, _rearm() re-registers on retry AND on the MPI-429 failover branch, retry timer cleared on cancel/stopKeep. tests/download-retry.test.cjs proves the retry re-requests with Range and the file verifies. npm test 463/463. Left: live proof that the real 25GB dep resumes from 8.4GB.

Added scripts/check-dep-urls.mjs + npm run release:deps at user request: HEADs all 215 dep urls and mirrors, exits 1 on any dead object. 215/215 reachable; proven to fail via a bogus CUBRIC_MODEL_MIRRORS base. It also corrected a wrong noMirror list I had put in the doc.

Live proof landed: the 25GB ltx23-transformer-fp8 resumed from 8.4GB at 24.9 MB/s and completed; LTX 2.3 balanced reads installed. validation.md written. maturity validating - not closing without explicit approval. Mirror-failover half of the _rearm fix is still offline-tested only.

Closed on user approval. Shipped de8c77bf (same-url retry gated on bytes-on-disk + _rearm re-registration on both in-place restart branches) and cd7601aa (npm run release:deps). Live-proven: the 25GB dep that failed resumed from 8.4GB and completed. npm test 463/463.
